title: The next horizontal tail is the kernel of the restricted signed projection
statement: Let $C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] in which every natural-indexed bicomplex has a total complex [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let $f:A\to B$ be a morphism of bicomplexes of shape $\mathrm{up}(\mathbb N)$ in both directions, and put $M=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(\operatorname{Tot}(f)))$, with extension along $\mathbb N\hookrightarrow\mathbb Z$. Let $F$ be a decreasing subcomplex filtration of $M$ with $F.\mathrm{complexStep}(r,m)=\mathrm{coneHorizontalStep}(f,r,m)$ for all $r,m\in\mathbb Z$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients; lem-sp-cone-horizontal-step-stable]. For $p\in\mathbb N$, $n\in\mathbb Z$, put $T=\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(f.f(p)))[-p]$ and let $g:(F^pM)^n\to T^n$ be the filtration inclusion followed by the signed column projection [def-sp-cone-horizontal-projection]. Let $i:(F^{p+1}M)^n\to(F^pM)^n$ be the degreewise inclusion given by filtration antitonicity. Then $\operatorname{im}(i)=\ker(g)$ as subobjects of $(F^pM)^n$.

source.place: Displayed first-filtration formula before Lemma 12.25.1 (label lemma-double-complex), and the source/target cone refinement of lem-sp-cone-horizontal-quotient-iso-exists, proof step 1.

proof.text: Construct an actual inclusion of each extended column into the extended total object. For a diagonal summand outside column p, totalDesc and ι_totalDesc show that horizontalExtendedProjection is zero; an invalid diagonal summand is already zero by ιTotalOrZero_eq_zero. For a summand in column p, projection followed by column inclusion fixes the summand. Extension by zero handles m

Use the cone biproduct to construct a signed column insertion s, with source coefficient (-1)^p and target coefficient 1. On each source or target generator in column p, projection g followed by s reconstructs the generator: the degree-identification isomorphisms cancel and the source sign squares to 1. On generators outside p, g vanishes. Every generator of the next tail therefore maps to zero under g, and Finset.sup_le shows that its arrow composed with g is zero.

The endomorphism 1-gs sends the p-tail into the next tail. Test this factorization on the source and target generators: index p gives zero by reconstruction, and any index h>p is fixed by 1-gs and belongs to the next tail. Pull back the next tail along 1-gs; the generating image subobjects are bounded by this pullback, hence so is their finite supremum. This proves factorization of the actual p-tail arrow through the next tail after applying 1-gs.

Put a=(F.step p).arrow.f n, b=(F.step (p+1)).arrow.f n, and i=the degreewise next-step inclusion. Evaluation of ofLE_arrow gives i a=b. The image equalities hF identify mk a and mk b with the explicit tails. Since bg=0, image(i) is contained in kernel(ag). Conversely, if R=kernel(ag), its arrow followed by a is fixed by 1-gs, so the preceding tail factorization puts it in the image of b. Factor it as t b and cancel the monomorphism a to obtain t i=R.arrow. Thus R is contained in image(i). Antisymmetry proves the claimed subobject equality.

lean.statement:
theorem coneHorizontal_projection_kernel
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n = coneHorizontalStep f p n)
    (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    imageSubobject ((Subobject.ofLE (F.step ((p : ℤ) + 1))
      (F.step (p : ℤ)) (F.antitone_step (by omega))).f n) =
      kernelSubobject ((F.step (p : ℤ)).arrow.f n ≫ coneHorizontalProjection f p n)
